## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue (if applicable).

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 🎨 UI / UX refinement
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🔧 Build / CI / tooling update

## Checklist

- [ ] Code compiles without warnings (`npm run build` and `cargo test`)
- [ ] Clippy checks pass (`cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings`)
- [ ] Comments are written in English where appropriate
- [ ] No regression introduced to offline local processing principles
- [ ] Tested on target operating system(s)
